summary: A second straight loss, but a mild one: the Nifty settled just 0.28% lower after recovering from a morning dip near 22,600, while midcaps and small caps fell harder.

detail.leaders: Nifty Pharma and Healthcare (Cipla, Sun Pharma, Mankind, Gland)
detail.laggards: Titan, Wipro, HCLTech (top Nifty losers); realty, consumer durables, FMCG, auto; MidCap −0.99%, SmallCap −0.81%
detail.tone: The final settle was firmer than the closing-auction print: Nifty 22,716.20 (−64.05, −0.28%), Sensex 72,529.07 (−242.65, −0.33%). The index recovered about 115 pts from the morning low, but broader markets lagged.
watch: FII/DII provisional flows (after Monday's ₹5,353 cr FII sale)
US PCE inflation Wednesday; Brent near $107
RBI MPC Oct 5–7, where a 25 bp hike is widely expected
